metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Volker Meyer — research tools and AI workflow utilities

plugins.name: research-toolkit
plugins.description: Multi-agent, evidence-grade research pipeline with parallel web research, triangulation, and a machine-readable evidence contract (claims + sources). Two dials — depth and assurance — add an optional blocking evidence gate, rework loop, and final critic; runs are persisted and resumable. Includes a research dashboard for aggregating results.

plugins.name: diagram-skills
plugins.description: Create beautiful dark-mode diagrams as Excalidraw JSON or HTML/CSS. Visual argument diagrams with hand-drawn aesthetics, automatic PNG rendering, and shared brand palette.
